about: Which tools made which Liminal Doors floor. The Collection page's T button reads this. Astra (2026-10-19): track which tools were used in which worlds and which ones get better, so the finished toolkit can be packaged. Paths link to the newest version on GitHub; when PR #2 is merged, change ref to main.

codex-image.name: OpenAI Codex image generation
codex-image.does: Drew the seven concept plates the floors come from (2026-10-15).

floor-cutter.name: Floor cutter
floor-cutter.does: Cut the seven plates into one picture per floor along their divider lines.

redline-sheet.name: Redline sheet maker
redline-sheet.does: Lays every floor out on one numbered sheet for redlines in Procreate.

contact-sheet.name: Contact sheet maker
contact-sheet.does: All floors at a glance, six across.

web-pictures.name: Web picture maker
web-pictures.does: Light JPEG copies of the floors for the Collection page.

stop-01-builder.name: Stop 01 builder
stop-01-builder.does: Builds Pinkscape: the booth, its floor and the spawn inside it.

stop-01-sky.name: Pinkscape sky and cloud sea
stop-01-sky.does: Sunset sky, the sea of pink clouds and the cloud puffs.

booth-builder.name: Phone booth builder
booth-builder.does: Puts the K6 kiosk together in Unity: baked maps, glass, the pink phone panel.

blender-booth.name: Blender phone booth
blender-booth.does: Models the K6 kiosk and payphone by hand-made rules, with baked wear.

asset-creator.name: Unity Asset Creator
asset-creator.does: The step-by-step checklist the booth was made with.

unity-stable.name: Unity Stable shaders
unity-stable.does: Our own shaders: Handmade PBR, Pink Glass, Sparkle, Sunset Sky, Cloud Sea, Cloud Puff, Candy Paint.

stop-02-builder.name: Stop 02 builder
stop-02-builder.does: Builds Faraway Field: the ground, grass, sky and doors.

field-shaders.name: Faraway Field shaders
field-shaders.does: Field Ground, Soft Lit and Soft Glow (the ground, the doors and stone, the motes and sparkles).

frond-grass.name: Frond Grass shader
frond-grass.does: Tall pink leafy fronds: wind gusts, a flutter per tuft, and bending away from you as you walk through (2026-10-19, after Pink Universe's look).

grass-push.name: Grass push
grass-push.does: Tells the grass where your feet are each frame, so it parts for you (Udon).

sparkle-sky.name: Evening Sky with sparkles
sparkle-sky.does: Dusk gradient, cloud streaks, a low sun, and a twinkling sparkle layer with big four-point glints and a faint nebula.

door-kit.name: Door kit and portals
door-kit.does: Shared door pieces; the portal fills the whole doorway, sill to lintel (Astra: "the door portals need to fill up the square").

portal-shader.name: Portal shader
portal-shader.does: A luminous veil with slow swirls, rising threads, a bright rim at the frame, and blinking glitter.

glitter-paint.name: Glitter Paint shader
glitter-paint.does: Door paint full of tiny mirror flecks that flash as you move and twinkle (Astra: "the door more glittery").

stop-03-builder.name: Stop 03 builder
stop-03-builder.does: Builds Pool After Closing: the tiled hall, the pool and its steps, windows, skylight, ladder and both doors.

pool-tile.name: Pool Tile shader
pool-tile.does: World-space tiles with grout and caustic light that wanders under and over the water.

pool-water.name: Pool Water shader
pool-water.does: Clear turquoise water with slow ripples, glancing pink reflections and glints.

pool-window.name: Underwater window and skylight shader
pool-window.does: Deep water through the windows (light shafts, caustics, rising bubbles) and the violet water overhead.

door-system.name: Door system
door-system.does: Forward doors go somewhere random; the door you arrive by keeps the real way back.

door-wiring.name: Door wiring and trip test
door-wiring.does: Connects every door and walks a test trip through them.

world-glow.name: Liminal Glow
world-glow.does: Our own bloom, so doors and motes glow.

desktop-test.name: Desktop test
desktop-test.does: Runs the VRChat SDK's Build & Test without uploading.

agent-queue.name: Agent queue
agent-queue.does: Lets Claude drive the open Unity editor safely.

shaders-shop.name: Shaders Shop
shaders-shop.does: Installs and keeps a ledger of the world's shaders.

cloud-floor.name: Cloud floor repaint
cloud-floor.does: Painted the grass and the stone path out of floor 01's picture with its own cloud sea (Astra, 2026-10-20: "just all clouds").

world-spawn-tool.name: world-spawn-tool
world-spawn-tool.does: Unity Unicorn's first steps for a new world: the public repo and the profile link.

doorspace-kit.name: Doorspace kit
doorspace-kit.does: Rooms, fields, doors, rain, snow, motes and skies for a Doorspace, then bakes its still parts into one mesh per material so the scene stays small; balls use a light 187-vertex sphere (2026-10-19).

doorspace-builders.name: Doorspace builders 04-36
doorspace-builders.does: One builder per Doorspace, each from its concept; builds, rewires and renders them, and keeps the Hierarchy labelled 'Doorspace NN · Place Animal' in order (LiminalDoorspaces.cs with A, B and C).

doorspaces-window.name: Doorspaces window
doorspaces-window.does: Jump between Doorspaces in the editor: Go, Door, Solo, Show all, Rebuild; Ctrl+Shift+D opens it, Ctrl+Shift+] and [ step through (Astra: "make it easy for me to navigate").

glass-shader.name: Glass shader
glass-shader.does: Clear or frosted glass with a fresnel edge and the Doorspace's haze: conservatory walls, office cubicles, orchard leaves.

vine-trumpet.name: vine-spawn-with-trumpet-flowers
vine-trumpet.does: Unity Unicorn's vine tool: vines that climb or hang along a surface with trumpet flowers in up to 10 picked colours. The Upside-Down Conservatory's vine curtains (grown at 1/1.7 size on glass lines, then scaled up).
